svg.title: The state agency and disbursements
svg.desc: The state agency and disbursements. A horizontal band of $100 of Medicaid spending, narrowing left to right as it passes 3 phases. At state agency, $98.75 remains in FY2030 against $100.00 in FY2024. At disbursements, $84.47 remains in FY2030 against $92.73 in FY2024. At claims to providers, $79.32 remains in FY2030 against $87.07 in FY2024. Marked below the band: Everything else, $1.06, at state agency, carried by enrollees; Work reporting, $4.11, at disbursements, carried by people who will not enroll; Six-month renewals, $0.75, at disbursements, carried by people who will not renew. The remaining provisions of P.L. 119-21 are marked but not labelled here; they are named in Figure 6.
